title: 🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE GOOD SAMARITAN – ARE YOU IGNORING THE HURTING? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE GOOD SAMARITAN – ARE YOU IGNORING THE HURTING? 🔥
📖 Luke 10:25-37 – "Which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers?" The expert in the law replied, "The one who had mercy on him." Jesus told him, "Go and do likewise."

❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, what does the Parable of the Good Samaritan really mean? Is it just about being kind, or is there a deeper message?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people think this parable is just about helping others, but it’s actually a powerful challenge from Jesus about TRUE LOVE, COMPASSION, and breaking religious hypocrisy!
🚨 If you ignore this message, you might be missing the heart of God!
⚠️ WARNING: If your faith doesn’t move you to action, you might not truly love God!

🔥 1. WHAT IS THE PARABLE OF THE GOOD SAMARITAN?
📖 Luke 10:30 – "A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, when he was attacked by robbers. They stripped him of his clothes, beat him, and went away, leaving him half dead."
🔥 JESUS TELLS A STORY ABOUT A MAN WHO:

✔️ Was traveling from Jerusalem to Jericho (a dangerous road full of thieves).
✔️ Was attacked, robbed, and left to die on the side of the road.
✔️ Needed urgent help, but was ignored by religious leaders.
💡 THE QUESTION: WHO WILL HELP HIM?
🚨 WHAT WOULD YOU DO IF YOU SAW SOMEONE BROKEN, LOST, AND HURTING?

🔥 2. THE RELIGIOUS HYPOCRITES – WHY DID THEY IGNORE HIM?
📖 Luke 10:31-32 – "A priest happened to be going down the same road, and when he saw the man, he passed by on the other side. So too, a Levite, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side."
🔥 THE PRIEST AND THE LEVITE DID NOTHING! WHY?

❌ They valued religion over compassion. (Matthew 23:23)
❌ They were too busy with their own lives. (Philippians 2:4)
❌ They didn’t want to get "unclean" by touching a wounded man. (Mark 7:6-8)
❌ They saw, but they DIDN’T CARE ENOUGH TO ACT.
🚨 HOW MANY "CHRISTIANS" TODAY IGNORE THE SUFFERING AROUND THEM?
💡 IF YOUR FAITH DOESN’T MOVE YOU TO LOVE OTHERS, IS IT REAL FAITH?

🔥 3. THE GOOD SAMARITAN – THE ONE WHO SHOWED TRUE LOVE!
📖 Luke 10:33-34 – "But a Samaritan, as he traveled, came where the man was; and when he saw him, he took pity on him. He went to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. Then he put the man on his own donkey, brought him to an inn and took care of him."
🔥 WHAT DID THE SAMARITAN DO?

✔️ He SAW the man and had COMPASSION. (Mark 6:34)
✔️ He STOPPED what he was doing and HELPED. (James 2:15-16)
✔️ He SACRIFICED his time, effort, and money to care for a stranger. (Proverbs 19:17)
🚨 TRUE LOVE IS MORE THAN WORDS—IT TAKES ACTION!
💡 ARE YOU A SPECTATOR IN PEOPLE’S PAIN, OR ARE YOU A HELPER?

🔥 4. WHY DID JESUS USE A SAMARITAN?
📖 John 4:9 – "Jews do not associate with Samaritans."
🔥 IN JESUS' TIME:

✔️ Jews and Samaritans HATED each other.
✔️ Jews considered Samaritans "unclean" and rejected them.
✔️ Jesus SHOCKED everyone by making the Samaritan the hero!
🚨 JESUS IS SAYING: LOVE HAS NO BOUNDARIES!
💡 DO YOU ONLY LOVE PEOPLE WHO LOOK, THINK, AND ACT LIKE YOU?

🔥 5. WHO IS YOUR NEIGHBOR?
📖 Luke 10:36-37 – "Which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers?" The expert in the law replied, "The one who had mercy on him." Jesus told him, "Go and do likewise."
🔥 JESUS’ MESSAGE IS CLEAR:

✔️ Your "neighbor" is ANYONE in need. (Galatians 6:10)
✔️ True faith is shown by how you love others. (1 John 3:18)
✔️ Love has no room for racism, pride, or selfishness. (James 2:1-4)
🚨 IF YOU CLAIM TO LOVE GOD, YOU MUST LOVE PEOPLE!
💡 WHO AROUND YOU NEEDS YOUR COMPASSION TODAY?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: LOVE WITHOUT ACTION IS DEAD!
📖 James 2:17 – "Faith by itself, if it is not accompanied by action, is dead."

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Walk past hurting people like the priest and the Levite?
✔️ Stop, help, and love like the Good Samaritan?
🚨 REAL CHRISTIANS LOVE PEOPLE—NOT JUST IN WORDS, BUT IN ACTION!
💡 WILL YOU SHOW THE LOVE OF JESUS TO OTHERS?

🙏 PRAYER TO LOVE OTHERS LIKE JESUS!
"Lord Jesus, give me Your heart of compassion. Forgive me for ignoring those in need. Teach me to love others selflessly, without excuses. Help me to be like the Good Samaritan and reflect Your love in my daily life. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
